decision.reason: Verified the steering lease/ack/release boundary: only a matching lease acks, repeat ack is a no-op, a failed turn releases to pending without loss or double injection, terminal (cancelled/delivered/failed/discarded) items are never re-leased, and a stale lease is re-taken after restart.

steering.lease: pending/suspended (or stale in_progress) -> in_progress + steeringLeaseId + bounded prompt
steering.ack: only matching leaseId -> delivered (payload cleared); wrong/stale lease -> no-op; repeat ack -> 0
steering.release: failed turn -> back to pending; old lease can no longer ack

independentVerification.kind: state-machine assertions over real queue functions
independentVerification.detail: Tests drive the real lease/ack/release/list functions and assert the delivery state machine (in_progress/delivered/pending/terminal) plus idempotency and stale-lease recovery. No separate second-agent verifier role was run.

acceptanceCriteria.note: Pending completions are leased to in_progress with a leaseId and a bounded merged prompt containing the result.
Only a matching lease acks; wrong lease is a no-op; repeat ack returns 0 (no double injection).
A failed turn returns items to pending; the old lease cannot ack; the next lease takes exactly one batch.
delivered/discarded/failed items are never listed or re-leased.
A stale in_progress lease is re-leasable so a completion is not stranded.
6 tests pass, scoped lint 0, harness validate/dry-run pass, comms 0, credential scan 0 hits, SHA256SUMS verifiable; only the pre-existing tsgo:core:test baseline is red.
